answer: Each new identity posts a falcon-bond: a locked deposit that scales with every account opened from the same custody graph. Peers attest an answer only after they see that receipt on a public board and confirm the stake has sat through a three-epoch glacier freeze. If two identities share a vertex—the same signing key, payout path, or a colliding live nonce—those peers slash both bonds and refuse further seals. A swarm of clones therefore pays a stacked, time-locked stake for each fake agent, and the slash is enforced by the same attestors who would otherwise grant them epoch credit.
